title: Data Centre - Warehouse Employee
full_description:
Rotterdam, Netherlands
€3.339,44 - €5.526,17
We are looking for a new colleague with a passion for logistics and warehouse management within a data centre environment. A service-oriented go-getter with a can-do mindset and good communication skills.
You will Delivering and maintaining IT applications and services in order to realize the organization's strategy in the field of information technology.
You will be part of the Data Centre Operations 2 squad which is responsible for the ING global data centre service. Managing the physical sites for access, providing physical Installations of the IT hardware, cabling on the data centre floors, maintaining the capacity (Rack, Power and Cooling) and managing our central warehouse.
You are , within the warehouse mainly responsible for:
Managing the logistic process in our warehouse.
Coordinating and handle inbound, storage, and outbound deliveries .
Maintaining inventory control and managing stock levels.
Operating material handling equipment safely and efficiently.
Collaborating with various departments to optimize logistics processes.
Maintaining a clean and safe working environment.
Processing decommissioned hardware in a sustainable way.
Remote hands service.
As a member of an energetic team, you will support further development and enhancements in our warehouse and the logistic process.
You will participate in agile work processes such as daily stand-ups. With your squad, you work on common goals and a shared backlog, develop skills, and gain knowledge.
Competencies - Behaviors:
Dutch speaking is mandatory.
Natural self-motivation and drive to take end-to-end ownership.
You like to be physically active.
Flexibility in working hours.
Self-driven, proactive, and organized, with the ability to identify what needs to be done and do it.
Intrinsically positive mindset with a natural tendency to see solutions rather than problems.
Working on-call shifts is part of this position.
Your education and background
MBO education; preferable logistics.
Proficient in logistics software and Microsoft Office Suite is a pre.
Good command of spoken and written English.
A job from 36 to 40 hours and a unique offer that fits in with today's times. We consider your home situation and your ambitions and help you to balance work and private life. Discover our employment conditions yourself.
A salary tailored to your qualities and experience.
Flexible working hours and the possibility to work from home.
Contribution to travel expenses.
24 vacation days with a 36-hour working week. If you work 40 hours a week, you will receive 27 vacation days.
Individual Savings Contribution (BIS), 3.5% of your gross annual salary.
Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities to realize your ambitions.
An informal working environment with innovative colleagues who strive for the very best.
There are opportunities to grow to another position.
With 60,000 employees and operations in approximately 40 countries, there is no shortage of opportunities for people with initiative who want to help people take a step ahead in life and in business. Do you want to work at the cutting edge of what’s possible and at the same time ensure you work with integrity and hold the customer’s interests at heart? Do you want to be surrounded by progressive, inspiring, diverse and supportive colleagues? Then there is no better place to invest your talents than at ING. Join us. Apply today.
Contact the recruiter attached to the advertisement for more information. Want to apply directly? Please upload your CV and motivation letter by clicking the “Apply” button.
Please note, multiple interview steps involving various business stakeholders will be part of the selection process.
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society.
